Role Description

## Position Overview Perseus Talent has been retained by a prestigious independent healthcare hospital in Greater Manchester to appoint an experienced Lead Clinical Nurse Specialist. In this pivotal clinical leadership role, you will champion patient care pathways, coordinate multidisciplinary clinical teams, and ensure rigorous adherence to clinical governance and Care Quality Commission (CQC) standards. ### Key Responsibilities - Lead acute patient care pathways and clinical assessments with multidisciplinary healthcare colleagues. - Mentor and provide clinical leadership to ward nursing teams and junior staff practitioners. - Maintain rigorous standards of patient safety, clinical audit compliance, and infection control protocols. - Act as a senior point of clinical escalation for complex patient consultations. - Support senior hospital leadership with continuous quality improvement initiatives. ### Person Specification & Credentials - Current and active NMC Registration (Adult Branch) with no restrictions. - Demonstrable track record of senior clinical practice in an acute hospital or independent surgical environment. - Strong knowledge of current CQC standards and evidence-based clinical governance frameworks. - Exceptional interpersonal and communication capabilities, with a patient-centred ethos.

A Relationship-Led Approach to Healthcare

Healthcare organisations operate in high-consequence environments where clinical capability, leadership, and compassionate communication are equally essential. At Perseus Talent, healthcare is our primary recruitment specialism.

We work closely with healthcare providers, clinical leaders, and healthcare organisations to understand their specific requirements, company culture, and the qualities needed to succeed in each role.

Clinical and Operational Disciplines

Our relationship-led model focuses on key professional positions where candidate alignment and long-term retention are vital.

Clinical Nursing & Care Delivery

Qualified registered nurses, clinical nurse specialists, ward sisters, charge nurses, and senior care practitioners across general, acute, and community healthcare environments.

Clinical Leadership & Management

Head of clinical services, matrons, registered managers, clinical directors, and operations managers leading patient care pathways and multidisciplinary healthcare teams.

Allied Health Professionals

Specialist therapists, radiographers, occupational health advisors, and healthcare practitioners registered with relevant UK regulatory bodies.

Governance & Compliance

Quality assurance leads, clinical governance managers, and audit specialists ensuring stringent adherence to UK healthcare standards and regulatory frameworks.

Note: Perseus Talent works on bespoke permanent and fixed-term appointments across independent healthcare providers throughout the United Kingdom.

Interview Preparation

Preparing for a Healthcare Interview: A Practical Checklist

10 November 2026Perseus Talent
A practical guide for healthcare professionals preparing for clinical and operational interviews, focusing on clinical governance, patient care values, and role alignment.

Interviews within the UK healthcare sector require a considered balance of clinical expertise, regulatory awareness, and demonstrable patient care values. Whether you are interviewing for a nursing leadership position, an allied health role, or an operational healthcare appointment, thorough preparation enables you to present your capabilities with clarity and confidence.

1. Review Clinical Governance & Regulatory Frameworks

In any clinical environment, patient safety and governance are paramount. Prior to your interview:

  • Familiarise yourself with the organisation's recent CQC (Care Quality Commission) ratings and focus areas.
  • Reflect on your understanding of local safeguarding policies, infection control protocols, and incident escalation procedures.
  • Prepare clear examples of how you have maintained compliance and upheld safety standards under operational pressure.

2. Structure Evidence with Precision

Healthcare interview panels frequently utilise competency-based questioning. When framing your responses:

  • Context: Succinctly describe the clinical setting or patient situation.
  • Your Role: Clearly differentiate your specific actions from the wider team.
  • Outcome: Detail the clinical result, learning points, and how patient care was positively impacted.

3. Prepare Meaningful Questions for the Panel

An interview is a two-way dialogue. Inquire about the multidisciplinary team structure, ongoing training support, and clinical supervision arrangements to determine whether the organisation aligns with your professional ambitions.

Legal & Compliance

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2026 · UK GDPR & Data Protection Act 2018

COMPLIANCE NOTICE: This privacy policy governs data collection and processing across Perseus Talent digital services in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and Data Protection Act 2018.

1. Who We Are

Perseus Talent is a UK recruitment consultancy specialising in healthcare staffing and talent acquisition (“we”, “our”, or “us”). We operate the website at Perseustalent.co.uk.

Data Controller InformationPerseus Talent acts as Data Controller for personal data processed through this website. Statutory company registration and ICO data protection registration references are available on written request to Perseustalent@gmail.com.

2. What Personal Data We Collect

Depending on whether you engage with us as a prospective candidate, client organisation, or general enquirer, we may collect:

  • Identity and Contact Data: Full name, business or personal email address, telephone number, and geographical location.
  • Candidate Career Data: Curricula Vitae (CVs), employment history, professional qualifications, clinical specialisms, and current job titles.
  • Employer Recruitment Data: Company name, hiring briefs, role specifications, and expected salary parameters.
  • Technical Data: IP address, browser type, and anti-spam challenge tokens used to protect our forms.

3. Lawful Bases for Processing

We process personal data in compliance with Article 6 of the UK GDPR under the following lawful bases:

  • Consent: When a candidate registers their CV and consents to being considered for relevant opportunities.
  • Steps Prior to Entering a Contract: When an employer requests recruitment terms or candidate introductions.
  • Legitimate Interests: To communicate regarding submitted enquiries, safeguard site security, and prevent spam.

4. Candidate Data and Sharing with Employers

We will never submit your CV or personal details to a prospective employer without first discussing the specific vacancy with you and obtaining your explicit agreement.

5. CV Upload Transmission & Storage

CV files submitted through our online registration are validated for file integrity and transmitted securely. We do not store CVs in publicly accessible web directories. On development localhost, files are captured in private local storage; in production, submissions are routed via encrypted email delivery.

6. Data Retention Schedule

Standard Retention ScheduleCandidate CVs and personal profiles are retained for an active period of up to 24 months, after which we will contact you to request consent renewal or securely delete your records in accordance with UK GDPR principles. Employer enquiries are retained for the duration of the recruitment relationship.

7. Your Legal Rights

Under UK data protection legislation, you have the right to:

  • Request access to the personal data we hold about you.
  • Request rectification of inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Request erasure of your personal data (“right to be forgotten”).
  • Object to or restrict the processing of your data.
  • Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent.

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us by email at Perseustalent@gmail.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the UK Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk.

Legal & Compliance

Cookie Policy

Last updated: November 2026 · Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR)

PRIVACY-FIRST POLICY: Perseus Talent operates a privacy-first website. We only deploy strictly necessary technical cookies and security tokens required for site operation and anti-spam protection.

1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files placed on your device by websites you visit. They are widely used to ensure websites function correctly and securely.

2. How Perseus Talent Uses Cookies

We operate a privacy-first website. At launch, Perseus Talent uses only strictly necessary technical cookies and browser session tokens.

  • Security & Anti-Spam: When anti-bot security (such as Cloudflare Turnstile) is active, cryptographic tokens are used to prevent malicious automated form spam.
  • User Session Preferences: Basic state to maintain form step continuity during active browsing.

3. Analytics & Advertising

We do not use third-party tracking cookies, advertising pixels, or behavioral retargeting cookies. If website performance analytics are introduced in the future, we will implement an explicit, consent-gated banner requiring opt-in before any non-essential cookies are stored.

4. Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding our use of cookies, please contact us at Perseustalent@gmail.com.
